result.reason: The clause fails both playbook positions. It creates an internally inconsistent renewal mechanism—renewal “only by mutual written agreement” or automatic renewal—and the 90-day non-renewal deadline exceeds the fallback maximum of 60 days. It also omits the required price-increase cap and conflicts with Sections II and III, which continue to require mutual written agreement. Unrelated termination language is preserved, but the renewal drafting is ambiguous and not professionally integrated.
